description:
Annotation record #12345 was entered by alice@example.com. The entry refers to data extracted from paper ID 12345678, and the annotator marked the pair as involving coreference (coref = true) with the two events occurring in different sentences (cross‑sentence = true).

The first event (E1) is a Gene_expression mention. It appears in sentence 0, whose full text reads: “The activation of gene X leads to increased protein synthesis.” Within this sentence the event spans token indices 5 through 8 and the trigger word “activation” occupies token indices 5 to 6. The tokens that constitute the event are “activation”, “of”, “gene”, “X”.

The second event (E2) is a Protein_synthesis mention found in sentence 1: “Protein synthesis was observed shortly after.” This event runs from token index 15 to 17, with the trigger “synthesis” covering token indices 16 to 17. Its token list is “Protein”, “synthesis”. The annotator recorded the temporal relation as “E1 precedes E2”, indicating that the activation event precedes the observed synthesis. The complete text surrounding both events (including any resolved antecedents) is: “The activation of gene X leads to increased protein synthesis. Protein synthesis was observed shortly after.”
